status_of_history: Decisions issued before the first sealed decision record have no verified issuance time. They are scored only descriptively (ledger/backfill.py) and never enter the evaluation below.

forecast.event: stock price return minus benchmark price return over the horizon is greater than zero
forecast.reference: the first exchange session close strictly after issued_at (the ledger's own clock); the horizon endpoint is that many benchmark sessions later
forecast.sessions: the benchmark index's own trading days; never forward-fill a missing close — a missing stock or benchmark close at an endpoint makes that outcome unscorable

US.primary: FRED SP500 (S&P 500 price index, keyless fredgraph.csv)
US.cross_check: SPY via api.nasdaq.com, labelled as an ETF price return

forecast.price_basis: price return versus price return; stock closes as traded, adjusted only for verified splits and bonus shares; cash dividends excluded on both sides; windows with an unverified corporate action are flagged
metrics: quantile coverage of excess_quantiles when given
comparators: base rate of outperformance from forecasts already matured at issuance (0.5 until any have matured)

tracks.if_flat: starting exposure 0: BUY opens a full position; HOLD and SELL stay out (long-only, no short)
tracks.if_long: starting exposure 1: BUY and HOLD keep it (no leverage); SELL exits

overlays.trim: exposure becomes 0.5 x current; never opens or adds
overlays.hedge_US_HK: short leg of exposure x max(0, beta60) in SPY (US) or 2800.HK (HK), capped at 1.0 x exposure, beta from 60 daily returns before issuance; unavailable if beta cannot be estimated
overlays.hedge_CN: hedge_mapped_to_trim: exposure x (1 - 0.5 x clip(beta60 vs CSI 300, 0, 1)); a partial exposure cut, not an economic hedge
overlays.stop: level frozen at issuance = reference close - 2 x ATR14; triggered by a later close below the level; filled at the next eligible open, gaps included; no stop or hedge at zero exposure

actions.execution: first eligible open after issued_at; CN: no fill at an open locked at the board's price limit (main board 10%, ChiNext/STAR 20%, ST 5%), retry next session; suspended days are skipped; CN T+1 (no same-day exit)
actions.costs: see ledger/fees.yaml — statutory taxes and levies verified from primary sources with dates; commission and slippage are declared assumptions; dividends are not included in v1 and outcomes are flagged accordingly
actions.reported: net return and maximum drawdown per track at 5/20/60 sessions versus stock buy-and-hold, benchmark buy-and-hold and the same-start do-nothing policy; overlapping episodes are never compounded as independent trades

inference.weights: each ticker weighs equally in point estimates; calls and distinct tickers are both reported
inference.intervals: ticker-clustered bootstrap, with a date-block sensitivity check
inference.missing: missing or immature outcomes stay explicit, never zero-filled

review_points.allowed_claims: first test of Brier skill versus the lagged base rate
calibration claim, or withdrawal of p_outperform as a calibrated probability

default_verdict: inconclusive — below a review point nothing is claimed and nothing is killed; a wide interval is inconclusive, not evidence of no effect
not_allowed: tuning prompts, mandates or role weights to realised returns of these decisions
HOLD-band hit rates as a correctness measure
reconstructing a missing forecast or issuance time from outcomes
